campaignRule: Preserve existing raw campaigns and published links. Family is a reporting group, not a rewrite.
releaseGate: Finish current 3-game rollout before new experiment posts. Do not batch-release all factors or close stage 3 from one post.
measurementGate: Use same-age windows and retain collection timestamps. Shared bio URLs supply channel totals, never exact per-video starts.

dataPolicy.reviewPoint: 72h; extend to 7 days for insufficient data; no repeated peeking to declare a winner

thresholdNote: Operational pilot thresholds, not statistically guaranteed sample sizes. Organic posts are not randomized trials.
